dct_description_sm: Accompanied by "Exposé der verschiedenen Pacific-Eisenbahnen zur erklärung der beiliergenden Karte." 28 x 38 cm.
At top of map: "Beilage zur N.Y. Handels Zeitung."
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Map of western United States showing drainage, relief by hachures, state and county boundaries, cities and towns, Indian and military reservations, roads, trails, the railroad network and the Pacific lines in heavy colors.
dct_title_s: Karte der verschiendenen Pacific Eisenbahnen und deren Verbindung mit anderen Bahnen; für die "N.Y. Handels Zeitung" gezeichne
